'''Farnis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he greeted a group of Republic aligned individuals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and prepared them to be transported to the [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] so that they could defeat him.
